text: As of 1 July 2026, Unit Telecom LLP held 75% of Transtelecom JSC's shares and state railway NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy JSC held 25%. In December 2025, businessman Timur Turlov's structures announced an agreement to acquire Transtelecom via Unit Telecom, subject to state regulatory approvals.
short: Unit Telecom holds 75% of Transtelecom; state railway KTZ holds 25% (KASE, July 2026). A sale to Timur Turlov's entities was announced in Dec 2025, pending approvals.

source.name: Kazakhstan Stock Exchange — Information on shares and shareholders of Transtelecom as of July 1, 2026
source.quote: "Unit Telecom" LLP 4,228,572 75.00 "National Company "Kazakhstan Temir Zholy" JSC 1,409,525 25.00
source.note: Register figures for holders of 10%+ of outstanding shares.

additionalSources.name: Kapital.kz — Тимур Турлов покупает Транстелеком
additionalSources.quote: На 1 октября 2025 года 75%-ная доля в «Транстелекоме» принадлежала ТОО «Unit Telecom», остальные 25% - АО «Қазақстан темір жолы».
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'As of 1 October 2025, the 75% stake in Transtelecom belonged to Unit Telecom LLP, the remaining 25% to Kazakhstan Temir Zholy JSC.' The article reports Turlov's entities agreed on 11 December 2025 to acquire Transtelecom, pending state approvals.
